# Current State Assessments

<!-- generated by `csa sync` from .agents/registry.yaml - edit the registry, not this file -->

Shared CSA framework for every project in this folder. Agents, skills and framework code live in `.agents/`
(see `.agents/README.md`). Projects are registered in `.agents/csa-context/PROJECTS.yaml`.

- Command reference: `CSA-COMMANDS.md` in this folder (setup, pipeline, analysis agents, helpers).
- Start with `.agents/bin/csa status` (or `csa status` if it is on PATH): it shows the active project and where each section is.
- Launch agents through `csa <verb>` (`csa agents` lists them) so the prompt, project and defaults are always the same.
- Never edit a working DOCX outside the pipeline: author -> `csa approve` (human) -> apply -> review -> cleanup.
- One section at a time. Back up before any DOCX change (the framework does this for you).
- Project facts live in `csa-context/<PROJECT>_PROJECT_CONTEXT.yaml` and the project's evidence, never in shared agent or skill files.
